subject: MissionBridge: vendor swap pathway + credit architecture
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@missionbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@missionbridge.com
Date: 2025-09-17T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: MissionBridge procurement follow-up and competitive quote

Hi Irene and Jordan,

Thanks again for taking time last week. Procurement asked me to share the incumbent vendor's latest renewal quote so you can see the ask and let us know if Redwood can match or provide an equivalent package. Key points from their offer: a 24-month contract, an upfront commit with a 12% volume discount, and a one-time migration credit of 30k applied as a rebate after go-live.

Our priorities are predictable unit economics and a low-friction migration (minimal service disruption). The procurement team would prefer a commercial structure that preserves runway when we switch vendors. Specifically they asked about:
- whether Redwood can offer a guaranteed migration credit vs a post-go-live rebate
- seat-tier or license offsets in year 1 to reduce apparent spend bump
- an accelerated onboarding window or waiver of professional fees

I attached the competitor quote for reference (missionbridge_competitor_quote.pdf). Can you send a concise counterproposal that shows total first-year cost, how credits are applied, and any deadlines for qualifying for special onboarding terms? We have internal approval for a decision by the end of September if terms are acceptable.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Sr. Sourcing Manager, MissionBridge
asha.patel@missionbridge.com
procurement@missionbridge.com

Attachment: missionbridge_competitor_quote.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-17T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MissionBridge procurement follow-up and competitive quote

Team,

Forwarding Asha's note and the incumbent quote. High level strategy I recommend:
1) Structured migration credit (recommended): offer a 6-month guaranteed credit delivered as prepaid usage credit at signature, not a rebate. This addresses their procurement ask for guaranteed migration credit.
2) Seat-tier offset: apply a 40% equivalent discount on the incremental seats for the first 12 months so their apparent spend is smoothed.
3) Professional services waiver: waive the onboarding fee if they sign a minimum 12-month committed contract by Oct 31.
4) Conditioning: credits applied only after a short migration checklist is met (to protect us from churn-abuse).

Please keep commercial simple on the first pass. Jordan, can you convert the above into a tight commercial bullet list and a one-page MOU? Grace, flag any CS risks in the migration checklist and confirm the estimated 4-week migration window. Markus, I added you to review the MOU language around credits and termination.

I attached our switch playbook for reference (redwood_switch_playbook.xlsx).

Irene
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_switch_playbook.xlsx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@missionbridge.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MissionBridge commercial outline and MOU link

Hi Asha,

Thanks for sharing the incumbent quote. Per our internal alignment (Irene, Grace, Markus copied), here's a concise counterproposal to match the economics while protecting both sides operationally:

Proposal summary
- Migration credit: USD 45,000 guaranteed, delivered as a prepaid usage credit at signature applied against generated token usage over the first 6 months. Credit is non-refundable and expires after month 6.
- Seat-tier offset: apply a 40% equivalent discount on incremental seats or seat-tier uplifts for the first 12 months.
- Onboarding fees: waived if an executed MOU is returned by Oct 31, 2025; otherwise, a standard PS fee applies.
- Commit term: 12-month minimum term recommended to qualify for the seat-tier offset. We can discuss a 24-month option with a slightly higher discount if procurement prefers longer visibility.
- Migration checklist: a brief technical validation (low-latency routing, model compatibility check, data egress plan). Grace will own execution and can provide a 4-week plan.

I attached a one-page MOU and a DocuSign link for convenience. Legal note: our credits are recorded as prepaid usage credits on the invoice and applied through month-end billing adjustments. Markus, please review the MOU and advise on any redlines related to data retention or credit clawbacks.

We can get this to procurement as a single-page commercial term sheet plus the MOU. If MissionBridge is comfortable, we can begin the technical onboarding in parallel to contracting to hit the end-of-September decision target.

DocuSign MOU: https://www.docusign.com/en/us/agreements/MB-4812
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/MB-4812

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachment: docusign_missionbridge_mou.pdf
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@missionbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@missionbridge.com, legal@missionbridge.com, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-19T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MissionBridge commercial outline and MOU link

Jordan,

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the clear commercials. Procurement prefers a guaranteed credit in the form you proposed (prepaid usage credit) but legal needs the MOU to include a short guaranteed credit clause rather than an advisory credit note on invoices. Also, legal is requesting a specific data retention clause: we must retain control over user-level logs for 90 days and have a deletion process for archived data.

Can you have Markus or your legal team connect with our counsel to walk through 2 small edits: (1) explicit language stating the migration credit will be applied upfront and is non-reversible except in cases of material breach, and (2) data retention details as described above. If those are acceptable, procurement is ready to sign the MOU and return by Sep 25. We would like to start a parallel pilot environment the week after signing.

Who should our legal team contact at Redwood to go over the MOU redlines? Also, can you confirm whether the prepaid credit will be visible as a separate line item on month 1 invoice?

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Sr. Sourcing Manager, MissionBridge
procurement@missionbridge.com
